## The production footgun

`async def` is not automatically faster. Use `async def` when you **await** async I/O. If the body calls blocking libraries (`requests`, sync ORM, `time.sleep`), prefer plain `def` so FastAPI offloads to a thread pool — or you will block the event loop.

## Stack

FastAPI + Pydantic v2 + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async + asyncpg is the common 2026 API stack. Keep create/update/response schemas separate so secrets never leak.

## Background work

`BackgroundTasks` for quick follow-ups. Celery/Arq for heavy or retryable jobs.
